chunks: And ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
A menstruating woman in ihram may wear an inner garment beneath her clothes.

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman being addressed in the ruling
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمَةُ: a woman in the state of ihram for hajj or ʿumrah
key_terms.غِلَالَةً: an inner garment worn under clothing

ai.seo_question: Can a menstruating woman in ihram wear an inner garment under her clothes?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning a menstruating woman while in the state of ihram. It states that she may wear a ghilālah, an inner garment, beneath her outer clothes, clarifying what is permitted in this condition.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2629 - Abdullah ibn Sinan narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"A woman in Ihram who is menstruating may wear an inner garment (ghilalah) under her clothes."
